title: Surreal Beetle Ouroboros
description: A large black beetle with a metallic green shell is intertwined with a black snake forming an infinity symbol on a green hillside. In the background, a giant bald head with wide eyes expels blue wavy lines from its open mouth, connected to colorful dripping lollipops, a pink donut, and a stained glass window filled with cartoonish screaming faces.
